boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten documented Sacred Heart settings for independent work, research, or small-group study, with access constraints noted where the university specifies them.

cards.title: Ryan Matura Library
cards.subtitle: 5151 Park Avenue
cards.notes: Start with the library for research or a longer work block. Its official page identifies it as a gathering place for study, research and collaboration.
cards.short_summary: The university library’s dedicated setting for study, research and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart describes Ryan Matura Library as a gathering place for study, research and collaboration and lists its Fairfield location.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current-hours page before visiting; its physical-space hours vary.

cards.title: Hawley Lounge
cards.subtitle: Academic Center
cards.notes: Use the charging points, couches and chairs for a between-class work session. The lounge is specifically identified as a convenient place to hit the books.
cards.short_summary: Academic Center lounge with charging access and seating for work between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: SHU says Hawley Lounge has charging places, couches and chairs and is a convenient place to do work.
cards.source_title: How Will I Get Involved as a Commuter Student at Sacred Heart University?
cards.access_notes: The cited university article lists lounge hours as 7 a.m.–11 p.m.; confirm current access before going.

cards.title: Graduate and International Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: East Building, West Campus
cards.notes: Choose a smaller nook for solo work or a small project group. The lounge is near Graduate Student Life and International & Immigration Services offices.
cards.short_summary: West Campus lounge with individual and small-group work nooks.
cards.evidence_claim: SHU reports that the Graduate and International Student Lounge has study spaces, collaborative workstations and smaller nooks for individual or small-group projects.
cards.source_title: International and Graduate Students Have a Place to Call Their Own
cards.access_notes: Located in the East Building on West Campus; intended for graduate and international students.

cards.title: Art & Design Student Lounge & Library
cards.subtitle: Art & Design Gallery
cards.notes: Bring reading or sketching to the chairs and tables, then browse the adjacent gallery books when you need a reference break.
cards.short_summary: Art & Design seating and book-browsing space with chairs, tables and a bean bag.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Art & Design Student Lounge & Library has chairs, tables and a bean bag for study or browsing books in the Art & Design Gallery.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Studio Spaces | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: This is an Art & Design department facility; verify day-of access with the department.

cards.title: Linda E. McMahon Student Commons
cards.subtitle: Park Avenue Campus
cards.notes: Use this campus crossroads when a public common area suits your work. SHU explicitly includes solo study among the ways students use the building.
cards.short_summary: Student commons documented for solo study as well as meetings and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart states that the McMahon Commons supports uses ranging from a solo study session to a full-house presentation.
cards.source_title: Linda E. McMahon Student Commons | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: A multiuse student commons; availability can be affected by scheduled university events.

cards.entity_name: Frances Xavier Cabrini Hall Study Rooms
cards.title: Frances Xavier Cabrini Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Cabrini Hall, Pioneer Village
cards.notes: If you live in Cabrini, use a floor study room for focused work instead of an apartment. The hall’s official page also documents its card-swipe entry.
cards.short_summary: Floor-by-floor study rooms within Cabrini Hall’s residential setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart lists study rooms on every floor of Frances Xavier Cabrini Hall and notes card-swipe entry.
cards.source_title: Frances Xavier Cabrini Hall | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Residential hall with card-swipe entry; access is for residents and authorized guests.

cards.title: Thea Bowman Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Thea Bowman Hall, Pioneer Village
cards.notes: Residents can use the study room on their floor, with a large lounge and kitchenette also available on each floor for a change of setting.
cards.short_summary: Residential floor study rooms paired with a lounge and kitchenette.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart lists a study room and large lounge/kitchenette on every floor of Thea Bowman Hall.
cards.source_title: Thea Bowman Hall | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Residential hall with card-swipe entry; access is for residents and authorized guests.

cards.title: Mother Teresa Hall Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Mother Teresa Hall, Pioneer Village
cards.notes: Residents can set up in the study room on their floor, then use the adjacent large lounge/kitchenette when working with a small group.
cards.short_summary: Floor study rooms in a Pioneer Village residence hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart lists a study room and large lounge/kitchenette on every floor of Mother Teresa Hall.
cards.source_title: Mother Teresa Hall | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Residential hall with card-swipe entry; access is for residents and authorized guests.

cards.entity_name: Angelo Roncalli Hall Common Study Rooms
cards.title: Angelo Roncalli Hall Common Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Angelo Roncalli Hall
cards.notes: Roncalli residents can use the shared study room in their suite and keep the suite’s kitchen and living room separate from their work setup.
cards.short_summary: A common study room provided within each Roncalli Hall suite.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart lists a common study room in each suite at Angelo Roncalli Hall.
cards.source_title: Angelo Roncalli Hall | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Residential hall with card-swipe entry; access is for residents and authorized guests.

cards.entity_name: Pierre Toussaint Hall Group & Quiet Study Rooms
cards.title: Pierre Toussaint Hall Group & Quiet Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Pierre Toussaint Hall, Pioneer Village
cards.notes: Pick the group or quiet room that fits the task, then keep the distinction useful: collaboration in one setting, individual focus in the other.
cards.short_summary: Pioneer Village hall with both group and quiet study rooms on each floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says Pierre Toussaint Hall offers group and quiet study rooms on every floor.
cards.access_notes: A residential hall space; access is limited to residents and authorized guests.
